changelog: Optional AI recommendations: connect any OpenAI-compatible model - Groq, OpenAI, a local Ollama server, OpenRouter and others - and the engine asks it to suggest new titles from each viewer's own watch history. Those become the You Might Like and Because You Watched picks, each with a short reason. It weighs what you loved, finished and disliked along with your favourite genres and people, and only surfaces a pick after confirming the title exists on TMDB. If the model is unavailable or a viewer's taste isn't established yet, it falls back to the built-in TMDB discovery automatically, and it only fills home rows - it never requests or downloads anything by itself. The AI settings now accept any OpenAI-compatible base URL, key and model; existing Groq keys keep working unchanged. Trailers can now prefer a chosen audio language, falling back to the title's native trailer.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
